stories.headline: US says it hit an Iranian missile site after Bahrain attack
body: A US official told Al Jazeera a missile launch site on Iran's Qeshm Island was targeted.
It was a response to an earlier attack on a US base in Bahrain.
Tension in the Gulf remains high.
stories.vc: Gulf strikes keep oil and shipping insurance prices volatile.

stories.statLabel: the route Iraq wants to avoid
stories.headline: Iraq's PM visits Lebanon to explore oil routes beyond Hormuz
body: Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi is visiting Beirut for talks on trade and energy.
A proposed project would link Lebanon's Tripoli to the Kirkuk-Baniyas pipeline.
The war has disrupted Gulf oil routes.
stories.joke: Every pipe dream needs a pipe.
stories.vc: New export routes would cut Iraq's risk from Gulf disruptions.

stories.statLabel: when the bid to fire Cook began
stories.headline: Fed governor Lisa Cook refuses White House hearing on her firing
body: Fed governor Lisa Cook won't appear before a Trump administration panel weighing her dismissal.
Her lawyers call the process unfair and predetermined.
Trump has tried to fire her since August 2025.
stories.vc: Fights over Fed independence can unsettle bond markets.

stories.headline: Pakistan weighs carving out new provinces
body: Pakistan's defence minister says new provinces could come as early as the New Year.
Proposals would split the existing four: Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.
There is no formal plan or agreement yet.
stories.vc: New provinces would reshape budgets and resource sharing.

stories.headline: Perplexity may file for a US IPO as soon as early 2027
body: Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas says its annual recurring revenue has passed $1 billion.
It could file IPO papers as early as Q1 2027.
India is now its biggest market.
stories.joke: From answers to an IPO question.
stories.vc: A Perplexity IPO would test public appetite for AI search.

stories.headline: Rediff files updated papers for a ₹600 crore IPO
body: Rediff, one of India's earliest internet firms, has filed updated IPO papers with SEBI.
The money will fund Rediff One, Rediff Pay and Rediff TV, plus marketing.
SEBI cleared its confidential filing two months ago.
stories.joke: Rediffmail, your comeback tour is here.
stories.vc: Old-economy internet names are testing India's hot IPO market.

stories.headline: Sarvam AI opens 'Token Factory' to run AI models in India
body: Sarvam AI now lets developers run its own and global open models like DeepSeek and Gemma through one API.
It charges by usage, starting at ₹15 per million input tokens for Sarvam 105B.
It competes with Krutrim, OpenAI and Anthropic in India.
stories.vc: Local AI hosting helps firms keep data in India.

stories.headline: Claude's India downloads jump 15x as ChatGPT's dip
body: Claude downloads in India rose 15x in the September quarter, Sensor Tower data show.
ChatGPT downloads fell 21% but it still leads the market.
Claude is now third in in-app spending.
stories.joke: The chatbot race has a new lap leader in growth.
stories.vc: India's AI app market is set to be worth $126 billion by 2030.

stories.headline: Waymo pulls freeway rides after a California order
body: California's DMV has barred Waymo robotaxis from state freeways after several incidents.
Waymo has suspended freeway rides nationwide.
The order was issued November 11 but made public this week.
stories.joke: Robotaxi, please take the scenic route.
stories.vc: Safety limits slow robotaxi growth and revenue.

stories.headline: Google will keep 'history off' Gemini chats for two months
body: Google will keep temporary Gemini chats for about two months, up from 72 hours.
It says the change improves safety as AI gets more capable.
OpenAI keeps such chats up to 30 days.
stories.joke: Incognito, but with a long memory.
stories.vc: Privacy rules around AI data are becoming a competitive issue.

stories.headline: 2 in 5 Americans will soon live under Democratic women governors
body: The US will have 15 Democratic women governors in January, up from two in 2018.
That means 2 in 5 Americans will live in states they lead.
Three more states will have Republican women governors.
stories.vc: Women governors are campaigning on energy bills and childcare.
